title: LIGHT IN THE DARKNESS
A PRAYER FOR STEWARDSHIP
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision

sunlit stone path autumn valley glow
golden hour quiet mountain meadow stream

scenes.a: When ledgers do not balance tonight, stay still.
scenes.sub: WHEN DAILY ACCOUNTS DO NOT ADD UP

scenes.a: The scripture promises in Psalm 112: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
A good man showeth favor, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
Father, as we guide our work and manage our daily bread, grant us quiet wisdom to conduct our decisions with honor.
Where resources feel thin and decisions heavy, let Your light arise in our darkness.
Provide for our home, sustain our family, and give us grace to be generous even in tight seasons. Amen. When ledgers do not balance tonight, stay still.
